description: Rushkoff breaks down the intellectual hubris driving Silicon Valley: Effective Altruism (EA), Longtermism, and AI accelerationism. From Sam Bankman-Fried’s FTX collapse to the tech oligarchs attempting to optimize human presence through code, Rushkoff exposes how treating human lives as simple spreadsheet inputs creates a dangerous ends justify the means worldview. Drawing on philosophers like Albert Camus, Spinoza, and Martin Buber — and even recent statements from the Pope — Rushkoff argues th…
classificationReason: Substantial discussion of AI accelerationism, Silicon Valley, and the societal implications of optimizing human life through code, but not specifically robotics.
qualityReason: Appears to be a developed philosophical and critical analysis drawing on named thinkers and contemporary cases.
